ADVISOR_ENABLED: Must be `1` or `true`, or the server refuses to start. `advisor install` sets it in the client config.
ADVISOR_PROJECT_ROOT: The folder `run_proctor_check` may look inside. Paths outside it are refused.
ADVISOR_READ_ONLY: Set to `0` or `false` to allow tools that write. None exist in 0.1. Read-only wins over `ADVISOR_GROUPS`.
ADVISOR_GROUPS: Comma list of tool groups to offer (`stack`, `proctor`, `booster`). See below for what each group may start.
ADVISOR_PROCTOR_TIMEOUT: Seconds before a PROCTOR run is stopped (1 to 900).
ADVISOR_BOOSTER_TIMEOUT: Seconds before a Booster plan is stopped (1 to 900). A plan is local and fast, so the default is shorter than a PROCTOR run.
ADVISOR_BOOSTER_BIN: Where `upgrade_path` finds Booster when the app has no `vendor/bin/booster` of its own: the path to booster's `bin/booster` (or a `booster.phar`). The app's own `vendor/bin/booster` always wins.
ADVISOR_MAX_CHARS: Largest piece of text one doc call returns (1000 to 45000).
ADVISOR_AUDIT_LOG: A file for a one-line-per-call audit log: time, tool, a hash of the arguments, outcome, duration. Arguments are hashed, never written.
ADVISOR_STACK_DIR: Folder holding the sibling stack repos; used only by `content:generate`.
ADVISOR_PRIVATE_DENYLIST: A file (kept outside the repo) with private strings to strip from the bundle; used by `content:generate` and the public-posture test. See "Releasing".
